title: Will the President's approval rating be between 38.0 and 38.2 according to RealClearPolitics? 38.0 to 38.2
rules: If the President's approval rating is between 38.0 and 38.2% at 11:00 AM ET on October 30, 2026 according to RealClearPolitics, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: The market will determine at 11:00 AM ET on October 30, 2026.

blind.reasoning: The RCP average was 38.5% around Oct 25–26, down from 38.8% a few days earlier, and other averages (Silver Bulletin ~37%, Pollsmax 37.3%) suggest some further downward pull. Hitting the narrow 38.0–38.2 band on Oct 30 needs a further 0.3–0.5 point decline that stops in exactly the right place. With typical daily swings of a few tenths, that band gets roughly 15–20% of the probability.
blind.falsifier: The RCP average on Oct 30 at 11 AM ET reading 38.3% or higher (e.g., stable at 38.5%) or 37.9% or lower after a burst of bad pre-midterm polls.

final.reasoning: The market at ~10.5% sits below my 17%, but my latest RCP reading (38.5%) is several days old and the market likely reflects newer polls, so I shade to ~13%. The small remaining edge over the 0.11 ask doesn't justify a bet given that information gap.
